about.title: An engineer who has also run a business
about.body1: I’m Faiz, a software engineer in Palembang. I started with front-end work and UI design, taught Laravel, and kept going until I could build a system end to end, from the database, API and interface to the parts that need machine learning.
about.body2: I currently work as a software developer at Loranet Technologies PLT, a technology company in Malaysia, while still running Berkala Digital, the agency I founded in 2025, where I lead the creative and IT teams. Running a business taught me something engineers often learn late, which is that software is only finished when the people using it trust it.
